title: Remember Your Lord in These Holy Days
body:
(WirExistierenNur1Augenblick, dt.)
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Labbayk Allahuma labbayk! Labbayk Allah shareeka laka! Labbayk! Inna 'l-hamda
wa ni`amata, laka wa 'l-mulk, la shareeka lak! “Here I am at Your Service, O Allah! Here I am at Your
Service! Here I am Allah at Your Service, and You have no partner! Here I am at Your Service! Yours is (all)
praise and favor and dominion! You have no partner!”
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! ...wa sall
'Llahu `ala Sayyidina Muhammad (s) wa `alaa aalihi wa saahbihi ajma`een wa man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan....
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem! (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum, ayyuha 'l-hadiroon, and a heavenly salute to those people who
believe in their Creator, the Lord of Heavens, Allahu Dhul-Jalaal (swt)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits)
Alfu, alfu salaat, alfu alfu salaam, thousands and thousands of glory and majesty on that one for whose
honor, majesty and glory everything was created, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and
sits)

O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum, and may heavenly blessings be on you who are living for their Lord's
servanthood.
O People! We have not been created to enjoy our egos and its pleasures, which are nothing! The honor that
we have been granted is for glorifying and honoring the real deputy of Allah Almighty, Sayyidina Muhammad
(s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) Allah Almighty is not in need of our glorifying or honoring! What is
that? The Dominions of Allah Almighty are endless, countless. This whole world and everything in it is going
to be less than an atom in the Endless Dominions of the Lord of Heavens!
Honor is just granted from the Lord of Heavens to you. The Lord of Heavens is asking to give you honor, and
He is asking from His servants to give their most high glorifying and honoring to His Majestic, Divinely
Being. What are we doing? We are doing nothing! We are like drunken ones. We are running after the
enjoyment of our egos, and for what? What is that? And this whole world is appearing from beginning up to
end, and like this it is finished! For us it is years, centuries, and hundreds and thousands of years, and like a
spark it is finishing!! Allahu Akbar, Jalla Jalaaluh.
O People! We are in holy days and Allah Almighty granted us to give much more honor and glorifying to you,
and to us. Don't be drunk!
O Mankind! From east to west, wake up! Ask Who created you, and ask what He is asking from you! Try to
learn for what purpose He sent to you from His deputies and messengers from the Heavens! Animals know,
but now people living in the 21st century are not asking. You are not trying to learn Who is bringing us into
existence and Who is taking us from this existence, disappearing. We appear for a short time and after that
we disappear! All people are between appearance and disappearance, finished! Yesterday all of you were like
that, small ones or smaller, and all of us came from the womb of our mothers. They are saying, "He was born
weighing 3 kg. That one is born weighing 4 kg." Sometimes they are saying, "Oh twins are coming, 3 kg each,
6 kg." Who is bringing them, and how are they coming? Ptuuh (spit) on those Shaytan people, agents of
Diablo, saying, "There is no Creator." They are under my feet!!!
Don't follow them, and don't go to their schools! Go to those schools that are teaching heavenly teachings. It
is haraam, forbidden to make universities! They are saying it is "Positive Knowledge" and they are the biggest
liars, la`natullah, Allah's curse on them! The biggest blame is on Muslim countries that are opening

universities such as “King Fahd University.” What is that university? What are they teaching? They are
teaching "There is no god," astaghfirullah! Why are you making those Shaytan centers? A big blame and
cursing is on them, in Turkey, Baghdad,..... Hijaaz, Egypt, Libya, Arab countries, and Sudan. They do not fear
Allah Almighty and Qur'an `azheemu 'sh-shaan just came from the Heavens to the Seal of Prophets (s). You
must take your knowledge from the Holy Qur’an, not from western, dirty thinking!
O People! From east to west, I am shouting to you! If anything is happening to you, there is no excuse for
you! Everything is in the Holy Qur’an, but some of those people are blamed, and Allah Almighty is saying:
•••••• ••••••••••• ••••• •••••••••
dhalika mablaghahum min al-`ilm, That is the limit of their knowledge. (an-Najm, 53:20)
They are reaching under the lowest level, not asking to come out of darkness to enlightened worlds and
enlightened universes, but they always like to be underground in the darkness of dark worlds.
O People! What are you doing? One says, "I am now finishing Oxford and I am going to majestaire." Kharra
`alayhum, “Crap on them!” Arabs may understand. Majestaire, kharra `alayhum. And Mankind is hoping to
be in safety, in enjoyment, in happiness or to live a sweet life on this planet, never! Never! Close down those
universities! Arab kings, presidents and dictators, close down those universities and open the knowledge of
Holy Qur'an from Heavens! That is your safe way to Paradise, and to live a sweet life here also, or your life is
going to be poisoned. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Enough. We are living now in the holy days of Dhul-Hijjah, and people are running to the Lord's
House, Ka`aba Mu`azhzhamah. Why are they going there, for it to be said “Hajji Ahmed,” “Hajji Mehmet”?
Astaghfirullahi 'l-`Azheem. Tawbah, astaghfirullah. They are shaving their beards and mustaches, saying,
"We are 'Hajji'." You look like women! How are you going to be Hajji? From where are you bringing proof
that you may shave your beard? And I am calling to Allah, "O our Lord! Make them not to come without a
beard, to be like my grandmother!" Say, “Ameen!!!” (Mawlana Shaykh laughs)
As-salaamu `alaykum! Allah, yaa Rabbee, Allah! Amaan, yaa Rabb! Ab`ath lana malikan, iba`th lana
sultanan, and sultan yaduluna `alayk wa yakhrub sultanat ash-Shaytan, everywhere from east to west, west
to east, south to north, “Peace be upon you, safety of our Lord, send to us a king who will show us the way

and destroy the kingdom of Shaytan.” May Allah forgive you and forgive me.
Fatihah.
Mashaa-Allah.
(Baya` and shahadah)
